items.title: Ralph Sutton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 22, 1995
items.q: And in the band he had Max Kaminsky, Jack Lesberg, Peanuts Hucko, Eddie Shaughnessy on drums and myself on piano.

ctx.x: And from then, I did that for about two and a half years and then I re-joined Jack Teagarden, he was going into the Famous Door on 52nd Street. And in the band he had Max Kaminsky, Jack Lesberg, Peanuts Hucko, Eddie Shaughnessy on drums and myself on piano.
You know, Ed Shaughnessy mentioned that engagement to us.
